race.description: Aviso Tas Insurance Brokers Mdn Plate
race.comment: VINRAAM (6) is a progressive type who has placed 2/3 so far. Tackled this trip last time and kept coming to just miss. Has upside and should go close. UNFILTERED (4) ran on well fresh to place then kept coming last time to finish midfield. First try at the trip and looks hard to hold out. WINDARA ROCK IT (7) was a bit disappointing last time when fading late but did run very well on debut when runner-up. Has upside and worth another chance. IRISH BLOOM (9) finished in the frame last time, beaten 1.3 lengths at this track over 1600m. Looks well placed here and expected to feature. ROYAL SCENE (10) is better than last run when drew off the track and can improve sharply.
